scientific_integrity: The original HED and expected-PD gain formulas are credited to Steel, Mimoto and Mooers (2007); only the sharp five-tip global-optimum boundary and its if-and-only-if topology/length criterion are assessed here. The stand-alone rational checks verify the illustrative case; the universal statement has a direct analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Rooted fully binary ultrametric trees with positive lengths only.
Common independent extinction risk, one guaranteed survival intervention, equal intervention costs.
No empirical calibration, general multicriterion conservation conclusion, heterogeneous-risk theorem, or independent scientific audit is asserted.
Specialized earlier coverage of the five-tip threshold may exist outside inspected primary texts.
title: Five tips are the sharp threshold for common-risk phylogenetic conservation-priority switching
